question: Which Lok Sabha was constituted after the General Elections to Lok Sabha, 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is " __**17th **__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In 2019, Indians went to the polls to elect a new parliament, the 17th Lok Sabha.**
 
• The Election Commission of India held **elections in seven phases **across the country **beginning on 11 April 2019 and ending on 19 May 2019.**
 
• One-fourth of the members of the current Lok Sabha are women.
 
• There are 267 first-time representatives. There are 233 people in this group who have criminal charges pending against them.
 
• It's estimated that 39% of members are also active in politics or social work in their professional lives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In India's general election of **2014**, representatives were chosen to fill the 16th Lok Parliament. The Electoral Commission of India held the polls in a series of nine stages, beginning on April 7 and ending on May 12.
 
• At the general election that took place in India in** 2009, **members of the 15th Lok Sabha were chosen to serve the country. Dissolved by President Pranab Mukherjee on May 18, 2014
